title: The Intervention Trigger Ledger
subtitle: Turn one observed customer change into an action someone can justify and own.
intro_text: Use this ledger for one recurring alert or leading signal. Connect the raw observation to a customer consequence, define when the condition is meaningful, and pre-assign the response before the next occurrence.
scoring_note: Do not total the rows into a health score. Record one trigger, test it in operation, and review false alarms, missed conditions, timing, and ownership.
closing_quote: A metric is not a signal. A signal is not a trigger. A trigger connects an observed condition to a pre-agreed response.
next_action: Choose one alert that created work in the last month. Review its five most recent occurrences, complete one ledger row, and test the rule on the next occurrence.
